ps3.2:1.3: iddhiyā kati bhūmiyo, kati pādā, kati padāni, kati mūlāni:
ps3.2:1.9: iddhiyā catasso bhūmiyo cattāro pādā aṭṭha padāni, soḷasa mūlāni.
ps3.2:2.2: adhiṭṭhānā iddhi, vikubbanā iddhi, manomayā iddhi, ñāṇavipphārā iddhi, samādhivipphārā iddhi, ariyā iddhi, kammavipākajā iddhi, puññavato iddhi, vijjāmayā iddhi tattha tattha sammāpayogapaccayā ijjhanaṭṭhena iddhi.
ps3.2:3.2: bhūmi paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ, pītisukhabhūmi dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ, upekkhāsukha bhūmi tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ, adukkhamasukhā bhūmi catutthaṃ jhānaṃ,
ps3.2:3.3: iddhiyā imā catasso bhūmiyo iddhilābhāya iddhi paṭilābhāya iddhivikubbanatāya iddhivisavitāya iddhivasībhāvāya iddhivesārajjāya saṃvattantīti.
ps3.2:4.2: idha bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, cittasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, viriyasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, vīmaṃsāsamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti.
ps3.2:4.3: iddhiyā ime cattāro pādā iddhilābhāya iddhipaṭilābhāya iddhivikubbanatāya iddhivisavitāya iddhivasībhāvāya iddhivesārajjāya saṃvattantīti.
ps3.2:5.2: ce bhikkhu nissāya labhati samādhiṃ, labhati cittassa ekaggataṃ,
ps3.2:5.3: chando na samādhi, samādhi na chando.
ps3.2:5.5: viriyaṃ ce bhikkhu nissāya labhati samādhiṃ, labhati cittassa ekaggataṃ,
ps3.2:5.6: viriyaṃ na samādhi, samādhi na viriyaṃ.
ps3.2:5.8: cittaṃ ce bhikkhu nissāya labhati samādhiṃ, labhati cittassa ekaggataṃ,
ps3.2:5.9: cittaṃ na samādhi, samādhi na cittaṃ.
ps3.2:5.11: vīmaṃsaṃ ce bhikkhu nissāya labhati samādhiṃ, labhati cittassa ekaggataṃ.
ps3.2:5.12: vīmaṃsā na samādhi, samādhi na vīmaṃsā.
ps3.2:5.14: iddhiyā imāni aṭṭha padāni, iddhilābhāya iddhipaṭilābhāya iddhi vikubbanatāya iddhivisavitāya iddhivasībhāvāya iddhivesārajjāya saṃvattantīti.
ps3.2:6.2: anonataṃ cittaṃ kosajje na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
ps3.2:6.3: anunnataṃ cittaṃ uddhacce na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
ps3.2:6.4: anabhintaṃ cittaṃ rāge na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
ps3.2:6.5: anapanataṃ cittaṃ byāpāde na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
ps3.2:6.6: anissitaṃ cittaṃ diṭṭhiyā na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
ps3.2:6.7: appaṭibaddhaṃ cittaṃ chandarāge na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
ps3.2:6.8: vippamuttaṃ cittaṃ kāmarāge na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
ps3.2:6.9: visaññuttaṃ cittaṃ kilese na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
ps3.2:6.10: vimariyādīkataṃ cittaṃ kilesamariyāde na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
ps3.2:6.11: ekattagataṃ cittaṃ nānattakilese na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
ps3.2:6.12: saddhāya pariggahitaṃ cittaṃ assaddhiye na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
ps3.2:6.13: viriyena pariggahitaṃ cittaṃ kosajje na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
ps3.2:6.14: satiyā pariggahitaṃ cittaṃ pasāde na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
ps3.2:6.15: samādhinā pariggahitaṃ cittaṃ uddhacce na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
ps3.2:6.16: paññāya pariggahitaṃ cittaṃ avijjāya na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
ps3.2:6.17: obhāsagataṃ cittaṃ avijjandhakāre na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ
ps3.2:6.18: iddhiyā imāni soḷasa mūlāni iddhilābhāya iddhipaṭilābhāya iddhivikubbanatāya iddhivisavitāya iddhivasībhāvāya iddhivesārajjāya saṃvattantīti.
ps3.2:7.3: ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti, bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti,
ps3.2:7.5: tirokuḍḍaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno gacchati seyyathāpi ākāse,
ps3.2:7.8: ākāsepi pallaṅkena kamati seyyathāpi pakkhī sakuṇo,
ps3.2:7.9: imepi candimasuriye evaṃ mahiddhike evaṃ mahānubhāve pāṇinā parāmasati parimajjati,
ps3.2:8.1: idhāti imissā diṭṭhiyā imissā khantiyā imissā ruciyā imasmiṃ ādāye imasmiṃ dhamme imasmiṃ vinaye imasmiṃ dhammavinaye imasmiṃ pāvacane imasmiṃ brahmacariye imasmiṃ satthusāsane.
ps3.2:8.4: bhikkhūti puthujjakalyāṇako vā hoti bhikkhu sekho vā arahā vā akuppadhammo.
ps3.2:8.5: anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhotīti nānappakāraṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti.
ps3.2:8.6: ekopi hutvā bahudhā hotīti pakatiyā eko bahukaṃ āvajjati, sataṃ vā sahassaṃ vā satasahassaṃ vā āvajjati,
ps3.2:8.10: yathāyasmā cullapanthako ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti, evameva so iddhimā cetovasippatto ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti
ps3.2:8.11: bahudhāpi hutvā eko hotīti pakatiyā bahuko ekaṃ āvajjati,
ps3.2:8.15: yathāyasmā cullapanthako bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti. evameva so iddhimā cetovasippatto bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti.
ps3.2:9.1: āvībhāvanti kenaci anāvaṭaṃ hoti appaṭicchannaṃ vivaṭaṃ pākaṭaṃ.
ps3.2:9.2: tirobhāvanti kenaci āvaṭaṃ hoti āvaṭaṃ hoti paṭicchannaṃ pihitaṃ paṭikujjitaṃ.
ps3.2:9.3: tirokuḍḍaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno gacchati seyyathāpi ākāseti pakatiyā. ākāsakasiṇasamāpattiyā lābhī hoti
ps3.2:9.9: yathā manussā pakatiyā aniddhimanto kenaci anāvaṭe aparikkhitte asajjamānā gacchanti evameva so iddhimā cetovasippatto tirokuḍḍaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno gacchati, seyyathāpi ākāse.
ps3.2:10.1: paṭhaviyāpi ummujjanimujjaṃ karoti seyyathāpi udaketi pakatiyā āpokasiṇasamāpattiyā lābhī hoti,
ps3.2:10.7: yathā manussā pakatiyā aniddhimanto udake ummujjanimujjaṃ karonti. evameva so iddhimā cetovasippatto paṭhaviyā ummujjanimujjaṃ karoti seyyathāpi udake
ps3.2:11.1: udakepi abhijjamāne gacchati seyyathāpi paṭhaviyanti pakatiyā paṭhavikasiṇamāpattiyā lābhī hoti,
ps3.2:11.7: yathā manussā pakatiyā aniddhimanto abhijjamānāya paṭhaviyā gacchanti. evameva so iddhimā cetovasippatto abhijjamāne udake gacchati seyyathāpi paṭhaviyaṃ.
ps3.2:12.1: ākāsepi pallaṅkena kamati seyyathāpi pakkhī sakuṇoti pakatiyā paṭhavikasiṇasamāpattiyā lābhī hoti.
ps3.2:12.6: so ākāse antalikkhe caṅkamatipi tiṭṭhatipi nisīdatipi seyyampi kappeti,
ps3.2:12.7: yathā manussā pakatiyā aniddhimanto paṭhaviyā caṅkamantipi tiṭṭhantipi nisīdantipi seyyampi kappenti, evameva so iddhimā cetovasippatto ākāse antalikkhe caṅkamatipi tiṭṭhatipi nisīdatipi seyyampi kappeti seyyathāpi pakkhīsakuṇo. ime
ps3.2:13.1: candimasuriye evaṃ mahiddhike evaṃ mahānubhāve pāṇinā parāmasati parimajjatīti idha so iddhimā cetovasippatto nisinnako vā nipannako vā candimasuriye āvajjati,
ps3.2:13.5: so nisinnako vā candimasuriye pāṇinā āmasati parāmasati parimajjati,
ps3.2:13.6: yathā manussā pakatiyā aniddhimanto kiñcideva rūpagataṃ hatthapāse āmasatīti parāmasanti parimajjanti. evameva so iddhimā cetovasippatto nisinnako vā nipannako vā candimasuriye pāṇinā āmasati parāmasati parimajjati.
ps3.2:14.1: yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vattetīti sace so iddhimā cetovasippatto brahmalokaṃ gantukāmo hoti, dūrepi santike adhiṭṭhāti:
ps3.2:14.13: dibbena cakkhunā tassā brahmuno rūpaṃ passati,
ps3.2:14.14: dibbāya sotadhātuyā tassā brahmuno saddaṃ suṇāti,
ps3.2:14.16: sace so iddhimā cetovasippatto dissamānena kāyena brahmalokaṃ gantukāmo hoti, kāyavasena cittaṃ parināmeti, kāyavasena cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
ps3.2:14.17: kāyavasena cittaṃ parināmetvā kāyavasena cittaṃ adhiṭṭhahitvā sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca okkamitvā dissamānena kāyena brahmalokaṃ gacchati.
ps3.2:14.18: sace so iddhimā cetovasippatto adissamānena kāyena brahmalokaṃ gantukāmo hoti, cittavasena kāyaṃ parināmeti, cittavasena kāyaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
ps3.2:14.19: cittavasena kāyaṃ parināmetvā cittavasena kāyaṃ adhiṭṭhahitvā sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca okkamitvā adissamānena kāyena brahmalokaṃ gacchati.
ps3.2:14.20: so tassa brahmuno purato rūpaṃ abhinimmināti manomayaṃ sabbaṅgapaccaṅgaṃ ahīnindriyaṃ
ps3.2:14.21: sace so iddhimā caṅkamati, nimmitopi tattha caṅkamati,
ps3.2:14.22: sace so iddhimā tiṭṭhati, nimmitopi tattha tiṭṭhati,
ps3.2:14.23: sace so iddhimā nisīdati, nimmitopi tattha nisīdati.
ps3.2:14.24: sace so iddhimā seyyaṃ kappeti, nimmitopi tattha seyyaṃ kappeti,
ps3.2:14.25: sace so iddhimā dhūmāyati, nimmitopi tattha dhūmāyati,
ps3.2:14.26: sace so iddhimā pajjalati. nimmitopi tattha pajjalati.
ps3.2:14.27: sace so iddhimā dhammaṃ bhāsati, nimmitopi tattha dhammaṃ bhāsati.
ps3.2:14.28: sace so iddhimā pañhaṃ pucchati, nimmitopi tattha pañhaṃ pucchati.
ps3.2:14.29: sace so iddhimā pañhaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeti, nimmitopi tattha pañhaṃ, puṭṭho vissajjeti
ps3.2:14.30: sace so addhimā tena brahmunā saddhiṃ santiṭṭhati sallapati sākacchaṃ samāpajjati, nimmitopi tattha tena brahmunā saddhiṃ santiṭṭhati sallapati sākacchaṃ samāpajjati.
ps3.2:14.31: yaññadeva so iddhimā karoti, taṃtadeva hi so nimmito karotīti.
ps3.2:15.2: sikhissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa abhibhū nāma sāvako brahmaloke ṭhito sahassīlokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpesi.
ps3.2:15.5: dissamānanepi heṭṭhimena upaḍḍhakāyena adissamānenapi uparimena upaḍḍhakāyena dhammaṃ desesi,
ps3.2:15.6: dissamānenapi uparimena upaḍḍhakāyena adissamānenapi heṭṭhimena. upaḍḍhakāyena dhammaṃ desesi.
ps3.2:15.7: so pakativaṇṇaṃ vijahitvā kumāravaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, nāgavaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, supaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, yakkhavaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, asuravaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, indavaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, devavaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, brahmavaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, samuddavaṇṇaṃ dasseti, pabbatavaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, vanavaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, sīhavaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, vyagghavaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, dipivaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, hatthampi dasseti, assampi dasseti, rathampi dasseti, pattimpi dasseti, vividhampi senābyuhaṃ dassetīti.
ps3.2:16.2: bhikkhu imamhā kāyā aññaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimmināti rūpiṃ manomayaṃ sabbaṅgapaccaṅgaṃ ahīnindriyaṃ,
ps3.2:16.8: seyyathā vā pana puriso asiṃ kosiyā pavāheyya,
ps3.2:16.13: seyyathā vā pana puriso ahiṃ karaṇḍā uddhareyya,
ps3.2:16.18: evameva bhikkhu imamhā kāya aññaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimmināti rūpiṃ manomayaṃ sabbaṅgapaccaṅgaṃ ahīnindriyaṃ.
ps3.2:17.11: āyasmato bakkulassa ñāṇavipphārā iddhi. āyasmato saṅkiccassa ñāṇavipphārā iddhi. āyasmato bhūtapālassa ñāṇavipphārā iddhi.
ps3.2:18.8: ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpattiyā rūpasaññāya paṭighaññāya nānattasaññāya pahānaṭṭho ijjhatīti …pe…
ps3.2:18.13: āyasmato sāriputtassa samādhivipphārā iddhi. āyasmato sañjīvassa samādhivipphārā iddhi. āyasmato khāṇukoṇḍaññassa samādhivipphārā iddhi. uttarāya upāsikāya samādhivipphārā iddhi, sāmāvatiyā upāsikāya samādhivipphārā iddhi.
ps3.2:19.5: apaṭikkūle paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyya’nti, paṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati.
ps3.2:19.7: ‘paṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūlasaññī vihareyya’nti appaṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati.
ps3.2:19.9: ‘appaṭikkūle ca paṭikkūle ca paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyya’nti paṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati.
ps3.2:19.11: ‘paṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūle ca tadubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekkhako vihareyyaṃ sato sampajāno’ti upekkhako tattha viharati sato sampajāno.
ps3.2:20.2: aṭṭhasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ mettāya vā erati, dhātūto vā upasaṃharati,
ps3.2:21.2: iṭṭhasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ asubhāya vā erati, aniccato vā upasaṃharati,
ps3.2:22.1: kathaṃ paṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūlasaññī viharati: aniṭṭhasmiṃ
ps3.2:22.2: ca iṭṭhasmiṃ ca vatthusmiṃ mettāya vā erati, dhātuto vā upasaṃharati,
ps3.2:22.3: evaṃ paṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūlasaññī viharati.
ps3.2:23.1: kathaṃ appaṭikkūle ca paṭikkūle ca paṭikkūlasaññī viharati: iṭṭhasmiṃ
ps3.2:23.2: ca aniṭṭhasmiṃ ca vatthusmiṃ asubhāya vā erati, aniccato vā upasaṃharati,
ps3.2:23.3: evaṃ appaṭikkūle paṭikkūle ca paṭikkūlasaññī viharati.
ps3.2:24.1: kathaṃ paṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūle ca tadubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno:
ps3.2:24.2: idha bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā neva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno.
ps3.2:24.7: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya neva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno.
ps3.2:24.8: evaṃ paṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūle tadubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno.
ps3.2:25.2: sabbesaṃ pakkhīnaṃ sabbesaṃ devānaṃ ekaccānaṃ manussānaṃ ekaccānaṃ vinipātikānaṃ.
ps3.2:26.2: cakkavattī vehāsaṃ gacchati saddhiṃ caturaṅginiyā senāya antamaso assabandhagobandhapurise upādāya,
ps3.2:26.3: jotiyassa gahapatissa puññavato iddhi’ jaṭilassa gahapatissa puññavato iddhi, meṇḍakassa gahapatissa puññavato iddhi, ghositassa gahapatissa puññavato iddhi, pañcannaṃ mahāpuññānaṃ puññavato iddhi.
ps3.2:27.2: vijjādharā vijjaṃ parijapetvā vehāsaṃ gacchanti, ākāse antalikkhe hatthimpi dassenti, assampi dassenti, rathampi dassenti, pattimpi dassenti, vividhampi senābyuhaṃ dassenti,
ps3.2:28.1: kataṃ tattha tattha sammā payogapaccayā ijjhanaṭṭhena iddhi:
ps3.2:28.5: tattha tattha sammā payogapaccayā ijjhanaṭṭhena iddhi …pe…
ps3.2:28.7: tattha tattha sammāpayoga paccayā ijjhanaṭṭhena iddhi.
ps3.2:28.8: evaṃ tattha tattha sammā payogapaccayā ijjhanaṭṭhena iddhi.
